# agyn_memory_bucket (Resource)

Manages an Agyn memory bucket.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "agyn_memory_bucket" "example" {
  title             = "My Memory Bucket"
  description       = "An example memory bucket managed by Terraform."
  scope             = "global"
  collection_prefix = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `collection_prefix` (String) Collection prefix for memory entries.
- `config` (String, Deprecated) Deprecated JSON-encoded memory bucket configuration. Use structured attributes instead.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the memory bucket.
- `scope` (String) Scope for the memory bucket (global or perThread).
- `title` (String) Human-readable title of the memory bucket.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID identifier of the memory bucket.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID
terraform import agyn_memory_bucket.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
